views.name: cbsa_basic_demographics
views.body_sql:
SELECT "geo_id" AS geo_id,
       "total_pop" AS total_pop,
       "households" AS households,
       "median_income" AS median_income,
       "median_rent" AS median_rent,
       "housing_units" AS housing_units,
       "vacant_housing_units" AS vacant_housing_units,
       "owner_occupied_housing_units" AS owner_occupied_housing_units,
       "commuters_by_public_transportation" AS commuters_by_public_transportation,
       "aggregate_travel_time_to_work" AS aggregate_travel_time_to_work,
       "male_pop" AS male_pop,
       "female_pop" AS female_pop,
       "white_pop" AS white_pop,
       "black_pop" AS black_pop,
       "asian_pop" AS asian_pop,
       "hispanic_pop" AS hispanic_pop
FROM CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2.CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS.CBSA_2007_1YR
grain: geo_id (one row per CBSA geo_id in the source table)
views.description: Selects core demographic and housing measures from a CBSA vintage table. Useful as a base cohort for filtering CBSAs by population, household counts, income, rent, or basic race/sex breakdowns before downstream normalization, ranking, or joins across vintages. | Use for: Filter CBSAs by population or median income; Map or join CBSA demographics to spatial lookups; Compute rates per-capita using total_pop (join with normalization CTEs)

views.name: blockgroup_population_age_sex
views.body_sql:
SELECT "geo_id" AS geo_id,
       "total_pop" AS total_pop,
       "male_pop" AS male_pop,
       "female_pop" AS female_pop,
       "male_under_5" AS male_under_5,
       "male_5_to_9" AS male_5_to_9,
       "male_10_to_14" AS male_10_to_14,
       "female_under_5" AS female_under_5,
       "female_5_to_9" AS female_5_to_9,
       "female_10_to_14" AS female_10_to_14,
       CASE WHEN "total_pop" IS NULL OR "total_pop" = 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE("male_pop",0)/NULLIF("total_pop",0) END AS pct_male,
       CASE WHEN "total_pop" IS NULL OR "total_pop" = 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE("female_pop",0)/NULLIF("total_pop",0) END AS pct_female
FROM CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2.CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS.BLOCKGROUP_2010_5YR
grain: geo_id (one row per block group geo_id in the source table)
views.description: Projects and cleans key population and age/sex buckets from block-group vintage table. Useful for computing normalized shares (e.g., share male/female, age-group shares) and for aggregating up to tract/county by extracting or joining on tract-coded prefix of geo_id externally. | Use for: Compute percent male/female or age-group shares in a block group; Aggregate block group age/sex buckets to higher geographies after extracting/deriving tract ids; Identify block groups with missing or zero population for special handling

views.name: cbsa_vintage_side_by_side
views.body_sql:
SELECT COALESCE(a.geo_id, b.geo_id) AS geo_id,
       a.total_pop AS total_pop_v1,
       b.total_pop AS total_pop_v2,
       a.median_income AS median_income_v1,
       b.median_income AS median_income_v2,
       a.median_rent AS median_rent_v1,
       b.median_rent AS median_rent_v2,
       a.housing_units AS housing_units_v1,
       b.housing_units AS housing_units_v2
FROM (
  SELECT "geo_id" AS geo_id,
         "total_pop" AS total_pop,
         "median_income" AS median_income,
         "median_rent" AS median_rent,
         "housing_units" AS housing_units
  FROM CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2.CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS.CBSA_2007_1YR
) a
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT "geo_id" AS geo_id,
         "total_pop" AS total_pop,
         "median_income" AS median_income,
         "median_rent" AS median_rent,
         "housing_units" AS housing_units
  FROM CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2.CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS.CBSA_2013_5YR
) b
  ON a.geo_id = b.geo_id
grain: geo_id (one row per unique CBSA geo_id present in either vintage)
views.description: Join two CBSA vintage tables on geo_id to enable vintage-to-vintage comparisons (one row per geo_id that exists in at least one table). Keep pass-through measures from both vintages with prefixed column names. Useful for change-over-time analyses where geo_id encoding is stable across vintages. | Use for: Calculate absolute or percent change in population or income between two CBSA vintages; Identify CBSAs that appear/disappear between vintages; Rank CBSAs by growth between vintages (use with a RANK CTE)

views.name: blockgroup_income_bracket_shares
views.body_sql:
SELECT "geo_id" AS geo_id,
       "households" AS households,
       (COALESCE("income_less_10000",0) + COALESCE("income_10000_14999",0) + COALESCE("income_15000_19999",0)) AS income_low_count,
       (COALESCE("income_20000_24999",0) + COALESCE("income_25000_29999",0) + COALESCE("income_30000_34999",0) + COALESCE("income_35000_39999",0) + COALESCE("income_40000_44999",0)) AS income_middle_count,
       (COALESCE("income_45000_49999",0) + COALESCE("income_50000_59999",0) + COALESCE("income_60000_74999",0) + COALESCE("income_75000_99999",0) + COALESCE("income_100000_124999",0) + COALESCE("income_125000_149999",0) + COALESCE("income_150000_199999",0) + COALESCE("income_200000_or_more",0)) AS income_high_count,
       CASE WHEN "households" IS NULL OR "households" = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (COALESCE("income_less_10000",0) + COALESCE("income_10000_14999",0) + COALESCE("income_15000_19999",0)) / NULLIF("households",0) END AS pct_income_low,
       CASE WHEN "households" IS NULL OR "households" = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (COALESCE("income_20000_24999",0) + COALESCE("income_25000_29999",0) + COALESCE("income_30000_34999",0) + COALESCE("income_35000_39999",0) + COALESCE("income_40000_44999",0)) / NULLIF("households",0) END AS pct_income_middle,
       CASE WHEN "households" IS NULL OR "households" = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (COALESCE("income_45000_49999",0) + COALESCE("income_50000_59999",0) + COALESCE("income_60000_74999",0) + COALESCE("income_75000_99999",0) + COALESCE("income_100000_124999",0) + COALESCE("income_125000_149999",0) + COALESCE("income_150000_199999",0) + COALESCE("income_200000_or_more",0)) / NULLIF("households",0) END AS pct_income_high
FROM CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2.CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS.BLOCKGROUP_2010_5YR
grain: geo_id (one row per block group geo_id in the source table)
views.description: Aggregates income bracket counts at the block-group row grain into three broader income-band shares (low/medium/high) normalized by total households. Useful when downstream questions ask for share of households in income bands or for aggregating these shares to higher geographies after summing counts. | Use for: Compute share of households in broad income bands at block-group level; Aggregate income counts up to tract/county by summing counts and recomputing shares; Identify neighborhoods with high concentration of low-income households

views.name: cbsa_rank_by_population
views.body_sql:
SELECT "geo_id" AS geo_id,
       "total_pop" AS total_pop,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "total_pop" DESC NULLS LAST) AS pop_rank
FROM CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2.CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS.CBSA_2007_1YR
grain: geo_id (one row per CBSA geo_id in the source table)
views.description: Assigns a dense_rank of CBSAs ordered by total population within the CBSA table. Useful to implement Top-K CBSAs downstream by filtering rank <= K. Exposes rank so callers can choose the threshold. | Use for: Select top-N CBSAs by population (WHERE pop_rank <= N); Compare population rank across vintages by joining rank CTEs from different vintages; Bucket CBSAs into quantiles based on population rank

views.name: cbsa_running_pop_share
views.body_sql:
SELECT "geo_id" AS geo_id,
       "total_pop" AS total_pop,
       SUM(COALESCE("total_pop",0)) OVER (ORDER BY "total_pop" DESC NULLS LAST ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_pop_sum,
       SUM(COALESCE("total_pop",0)) OVER () AS total_pop_all,
       CASE WHEN SUM(COALESCE("total_pop",0)) OVER () = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(COALESCE("total_pop",0)) OVER (ORDER BY "total_pop" DESC NULLS LAST ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE("total_pop",0)) OVER (),0) END AS cumulative_pop_share
FROM CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2.CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS.CBSA_2007_1YR
grain: geo_id (one row per CBSA geo_id in the source table)
views.description: Computes cumulative population share of CBSAs ordered by population. Useful to understand concentration of population across CBSAs (e.g., how many CBSAs account for X% of population) — callers can filter by cumulative_share <= threshold. | Use for: Find number of CBSAs covering X% of total population (filter cumulative_pop_share <= X); Plot Lorenz-like concentration of population across CBSAs; Combine with rank CTE to report both rank and cumulative share

views.name: blockgroup_housing_type_distribution
views.body_sql:

       'dwellings_1_units_detached' AS dwelling_type,

UNION ALL
SELECT "geo_id" AS geo_id,
       'dwellings_2_units' AS dwelling_type,

FROM CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2.CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS.BLOCKGROUP_2010_5YR
UNION ALL
SELECT "geo_id" AS geo_id,
       'dwellings_3_to_4_units' AS dwelling_type,
       "dwellings_3_to_4_units" AS count
FROM CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2.CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS.BLOCKGROUP_2010_5YR
UNION ALL
SELECT "geo_id" AS geo_id,
       'dwellings_5_to_9_units' AS dwelling_type,
       "dwellings_5_to_9_units" AS count
FROM CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2.CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS.BLOCKGROUP_2010_5YR
UNION ALL
SELECT "geo_id" AS geo_id,

FROM CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2.CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS.BLOCKGROUP_2010_5YR
UNION ALL
SELECT "geo_id" AS geo_id,
       'dwellings_20_to_49_units' AS dwelling_type,

SELECT "geo_id" AS geo_id,
       'mobile_homes' AS dwelling_type,

FROM CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2.CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS.BLOCKGROUP_2010_5YR
grain: geo_id + dwelling_type (one row per block group and dwelling type)
views.description: Unpivots dwelling unit count columns at the block-group grain into (dwelling_type, count) rows. Useful for analyses that need a tall representation of housing type distribution or for aggregating specific dwelling types across geographies. | Use for: Compare distribution of dwelling types across block groups or aggregate by tract/county; Select block groups dominated by a particular dwelling_type (filter dwelling_type = X and count > threshold); Visualize housing stock mix using tall format

views.name: cbsa_employment_education_summary
views.body_sql:
SELECT "geo_id" AS geo_id,
       "civilian_labor_force" AS civilian_labor_force,
       "employed_pop" AS employed_pop,
       "unemployed_pop" AS unemployed_pop,
       "not_in_labor_force" AS not_in_labor_force,
       "pop_25_years_over" AS pop_25_years_over,
       "less_than_high_school_graduate" AS less_than_high_school_graduate,
       "high_school_including_ged" AS high_school_including_ged,
       "bachelors_degree_or_higher_25_64" AS bachelors_degree_or_higher_25_64,
       "graduate_professional_degree" AS graduate_professional_degree
FROM CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2.CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS.CBSA_2007_1YR
grain: geo_id (one row per CBSA geo_id in the source table)
views.description: Provides a compact summary of employment and education measures from a CBSA table, exposing employment counts and key education attainment measures. Useful as a semantic building block for labor-market or education attainment dashboards and comparisons across CBSAs. | Use for: Compute unemployment rate = unemployed_pop / civilian_labor_force (use this CTE as input); Compare education attainment shares across CBSAs; Filter CBSAs by education attainment thresholds
